name: 考研词汇
description: 考研英语核心词汇，收录 3728 高频词。

words.chinese: 相互抵消；取消；删去， 划掉； 把…作废
words.definition: to decide that something that was officially planned will not happen
examples: "Our flight was cancelled."
"I’m afraid I’ll have to cancel our meeting tomorrow."
"You’ll just have to ring John and cancel."

words.chinese: 爆炸的， 爆发的；使人冲动的； 导致猛烈爆发的；爆炸物， 炸药
words.definition: able or likely to explode
examples: "Because the gas is highly explosive, it needs to be kept in high-pressure containers."
"A small explosive device (= bomb ) was set off outside the UN headquarters today."

words.chinese: 外科医生
words.definition: a doctor who does operations in a hospital
examples: "...a heart surgeon."

words.chinese: 突然的， 意外的；唐突的， 鲁莽的
words.definition: sudden and unexpected
examples: "an abrupt change of plan"

words.chinese: 使泄气， 使失去信心； 阻碍
words.definition: to make someone less confident or less willing to do something
examples: "You should not let one failure discourage you."

words.chinese: 薪金， 薪水
words.definition: money that you receive as payment from the organization you work for, usually paid to you every month
examples: "The average salary for a teacher is $39,000 a year."

words.chinese: 自发的， 自然产生的
words.definition: something that is spontaneous has not been planned or organized, but happens by itself, or because you suddenly feel you want to do it
examples: "The crowd gave a spontaneous cheer."
"My spontaneous reaction was to run away."

words.chinese: 失事的船， 残骸；失事；失事， 遇难；破坏， 毁坏
words.definition: a ship that has sunk
examples: "He was still alive when they pulled him from the wreck."

words.chinese: 兔子
words.definition: a small animal with long ears and soft fur, that lives in a hole in the ground
examples: "Is that your rabbit?"

words.chinese: 阴沉的， 阴暗的；令人沮丧的， 抑郁的
words.definition: making you feel that things will not improve
examples: "The report paints a gloomy picture of the economy."

words.chinese: 责备,耻辱
words.definition: something that should make a person, society etc feel bad or ashamed
examples: "These derelict houses are a reproach to the city."

words.chinese: 正当理由；许可证； 委任状；保证， 担保
words.definition: a legal document that is signed by a judge, allowing the police to take a particular action
examples: "The company issued warrants for 300,000 shares."

words.chinese: 缘故
words.definition: in order to help, improve, or please someone or something
examples: "He moved to the seaside for the sake of his health."
"I only went for Kay’s sake."
"I hope he’s told the truth for his own sake (= because it will be good for him ) ."

words.chinese: 隐藏， 隐瞒， 隐蔽
words.definition: to hide something carefully
examples: "The shadows concealed her as she crept up to the house."
"The path was concealed by long grass."
"a concealed weapon"

words.chinese: 以鼻吸气， 用力吸入；嗅， 闻；吸气；嗅， 闻
words.definition: to breathe air into your nose noisily, for example when you are crying or have a cold
examples: "Margaret sniffed miserably and nodded."
"Stop sniffing and blow your nose."

words.chinese: 叙述的；有故事性的；叙述； 记叙文
words.definition: a description of events in a story, especially in a novel
examples: "If this story must be written, we must have the courage to eliminate all adjectives that tend to excite wonder: they would achieve the opposite effect, of impoverishing the narrative."

words.chinese: 有能力的， 胜任的
words.definition: having enough skill or knowledge to do something to a satisfactory standard
examples: "A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem."

words.chinese: 投资， 投资额
words.definition: the use of money to get a profit or to make a business activity successful, or the money that is used
examples: "We plan to buy some property as an investment."

words.chinese: 和…一致， 相符， 相同
words.definition: if two people’s ideas, opinions etc coincide, they are the same
examples: "The interests of the US and those of the islanders may not coincide."

words.chinese: 抓， 搔， 扒；抓， 搔； 抓痕；起跑线
words.definition: to rub your skin with your nails because it feels uncomfortable
examples: "John yawned and scratched his leg."
"Try not to scratch."

words.chinese: 圆的， 环形的 A；循环的；传单， 通报
words.definition: shaped like a circle
examples: "a circular table"

words.chinese: 发出嘀嗒声； 使发出咔嚓声；嘀嗒声， 咔哒声， 咔嚓声
words.definition: to make a short hard sound, or make something produce this sound
examples: "The door clicked shut behind me."
"Mother clicked her tongue (= made a short sound to show disapproval ) and sighed."
"Edmund clicked his fingers (= made a short sound to get someone’s attention ) for John to follow him."
"Vogel clicked his heels (= hit the heels of his shoes together ) and bowed."
"Twist the lever and the gears click into place ."

words.chinese: 合作的， 协作的；合作社
words.definition: willing to cooperate
examples: "He was doing his best to be cooperative."
"a cooperative witness"

words.chinese: 三部分的； 三方的；三倍的， 三重的；增至三倍
words.definition: having three parts or involving three groups, people, events etc
examples: "a triple murder investigation"
"a triple bill of horror movies"
"the triple world champion"
"a triple bypass heart operation"

words.chinese: 脾气， 情绪；韧度； 回火度；减缓； 调和， 调节
words.definition: a tendency to become angry suddenly or easily
examples: "That temper of hers will get her into trouble one of these days."
"According to Nathan, Robin has quite a temper ."
"Theo needs to learn to control his temper ."

words.chinese: 欢庆； 高兴
examples: "Today you may rejoice because of contacts, news or visits from friends who live in another city or country."
"Why is it that we rejoice at a birth and grieve at a funeral? Is it because we are not the person concerned?"

words.chinese: 向旁边； 侧身； 横着； 斜着；向旁边的； 侧身的； 横着的； 斜着的
words.definition: to or towards one side
examples: "A strong gust of wind blew the car sideways into the ditch."
"Alfred shot him a sideways glance."

words.chinese: 法规， 章程， 规则
words.definition: a law passed by a parliament, council etc and formally written down
examples: "Protection for the consumer is laid down by statute (= established by law ) ."

words.chinese: 悬崖， 峭壁
words.definition: a large area of rock or a mountain with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river
examples: "The car rolled over the edge of a cliff."

words.chinese: 无限的， 无穷的；无限
words.definition: without limits in space or time
examples: "The universe is infinite."

words.chinese: 满足， 满意；足够
words.definition: to be enough
examples: "A light lunch will suffice ."

words.chinese: 值得注意的， 显著的； 著名的
words.definition: important, interesting, excellent, or unusual enough to be noticed or mentioned
examples: "Every country in the world signed the treaty, with one notable exception - the United States."

words.chinese: 承认， 承认…为真；退让， 允许， 让步， 给予 A
words.definition: to admit that something is true or correct, although you wish it were not true
examples: "‘That’s the only possible solution.’ ‘Yes, I suppose so,’ Charles conceded."

words.chinese: 选举， 推选；选择
words.definition: to choose someone for an official position by voting
examples: "the country’s first democratically elected government"
"a new method for electing the leader of the party"

words.chinese: 高尔夫球
words.definition: a game in which the players hit a small white ball into holes in the ground with a set of golf clubs, using as few hits as possible
examples: "He plays golf on Sundays."
"a round of golf"

words.chinese: 自私的， 利己的
words.definition: caring only about yourself and not about other people – used to show disapproval
examples: "How can you be so selfish?"
"selfish behaviour"

words.chinese: 蒸发
words.definition: if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas
examples: "Most of the water had evaporated."
"The sun evaporates moisture on the leaves."

words.chinese: 委员会；委任， 授权； 代办；佣金， 手续费
words.definition: a group of people who have been given the official job of finding out about something or controlling something
examples: "The Government set up a commission to investigate allegations of police violence."

words.chinese: 楼梯
words.definition: a set of stairs inside a building with its supports and the side parts that you hold on to
examples: "They walked down the staircase together."

words.chinese: 理性的； 合理的
words.definition: rational thoughts, decisions etc are based on reasons rather than emotions
examples: "Parents need to be fully informed so they can make a rational decision."
"I’m sure there’s a rational explanation for all this."
"It’s impossible to have a rational conversation with him."

words.chinese: 政策， 方针 A
words.definition: a way of doing something that has been officially agreed and chosen by a political party, a business, or another organization
examples: "...plans that include changes in foreign policy and economic reforms."

words.chinese: 再继续， 重新开始
words.definition: to start doing something again after stopping or being interrupted
examples: "She hopes to resume work after the baby is born."
"The rebels have resumed hostilities against government troops."

words.chinese: 摆出姿势， 装模作样；姿势， 体态；看法， 态度
words.definition: You can say that someone is posturing when you disapprove of their behaviour because you think they are trying to give a particular impression in order to deceive people
examples: "She says the president may just be posturing."

words.chinese: 盘旋上升；不断急剧地上升；螺旋形的； 盘旋的 A；螺旋； 螺旋式的上升 A
words.definition: to move in a continuous curve that gets nearer to or further from its central point as it goes round
examples: "Crime has spiraled out of control ."
"...a spiral staircase."

words.chinese: 艺术的， 美术的
words.definition: relating to art or culture
examples: "artistic work"
"Opinion about the artistic merit of his paintings has been mixed."

words.chinese: 职业， 行业
words.definition: a particular type of work that you feel is right for you
examples: "At 17 she found her true vocation as a writer."

words.chinese: 止步， 停止；止步， 停步， 停止前进
words.definition: to prevent someone or something from continuing - used especially in news reports
examples: "The government has failed to halt economic decline."
"Safety concerns have led them to halt work on the dam."

words.chinese: 日落
words.definition: the time of day when the sun disappears and night begins
examples: "a glorious sunset"

words.chinese: 明显的， 显而易见的
words.definition: easy to notice or understand
examples: "The obvious way of reducing pollution is to use cars less."

words.chinese: 外科， 外科学； 外科手术治疗；手术室， 诊疗室
words.definition: medical treatment in which a surgeon cuts open your body to repair or remove something inside
examples: "Dr. Hanson is in surgery."

words.chinese: 猛烈的， 激烈的；暴力引起的， 强暴的
words.definition: involving actions that are intended to injure or kill people, by hitting them, shooting them etc
examples: "the increase in violent crime"
"violent clashes between the police and demonstrators"
"31 people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day."
"The riots ended in the violent deaths of three teenagers."

words.chinese: 决心， 决定 <；分解， 溶解；决议；解决；解决， 解答；决心；决议
words.definition: to find a satisfactory way of dealing with a problem or difficulty
examples: "Barnet was desperate for money to resolve his financial problems."

words.chinese: 使面临， 使遭遇；面对
words.definition: if a problem, difficulty etc confronts you, it appears and needs to be dealt with
examples: "The problems confronting the new government were enormous."

words.chinese: 守信的， 忠实的； 如实的
words.definition: remaining loyal to a particular person, belief, political party etc and continuing to support them
examples: "a faithful friend"
"years of faithful service to the company"
"our faithful family dog, Bogey"
"a faithful member of the church"

words.chinese: 生殖， 繁殖；翻版； 复制， 仿造
words.definition: if an animal or plant reproduces, or reproduces itself, it produces young plants or animals
examples: "The turtles return to the coast to reproduce."

words.chinese: 聚集在一起， 挤作一团；挤在一起的人， 一堆杂乱的东西
words.definition: if a group of people huddle together, they stay very close to each other, especially because they are cold or frightened
examples: "We lay huddled together for warmth."

words.chinese: 骨骼； 骨架； 框架；梗概， 提要
words.definition: the most important parts of something, to which more detail can be added later
examples: "We agreed on a skeleton outline of the proposal."

words.chinese: 文盲的， 未受教育的
words.definition: someone who is illiterate has not learned to read or write
examples: "It was an illiterate letter, full of mistakes."

words.chinese: 十字路口； 交点
words.definition: a place where roads, lines etc cross each other, especially where two roads meet
examples: "We crossed at a busy intersection."

words.chinese: 奖学金 A；学问， 学识
words.definition: an amount of money that is given to someone by an educational organization to help pay for their education
examples: "Her latest publication is a fine piece of scholarship."

words.chinese: 而且， 还有；除…之外
words.definition: used when adding another reason
examples: "I need the money. And besides, when I agree to do something, I do it."

words.chinese: 介词
words.definition: a word that is used before a noun,  pronoun  , or  gerund  to show place, time, direction etc. In the phrase ‘the trees in the park’, ‘in’ is a preposition.
examples: "There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong."

words.chinese: 分散， 驱散， 解散
words.definition: if a group of people disperse or are dispersed, they go away in different directions
examples: "Police used tear gas to disperse the crowd."

words.chinese: 使生效； 实施； 执行， 贯彻 ；工具， 器具
words.definition: to take action or make changes that you have officially decided should happen
examples: "The government promised to implement a new system to control financial loan institutions."

words.chinese: 输出， 出口；输出， 出口；出口商品
words.definition: to sell goods to another country
examples: "Italian food has been exported all over the world."

words.chinese: 想象， 幻想；幻想的产物
words.definition: an exciting and unusual experience or situation you imagine happening to you, but which will probably never happen
examples: "I used to have fantasies about living in Paris with an artist."
"sexual fantasies"
"Young children sometimes can’t distinguish between fantasy and reality."
"He lived in a fantasy world of his own, even as a small boy."

words.chinese: 理智的， 明智的， 清醒的；心智健全的；合情合理的
words.definition: able to think in a normal and reasonable way
examples: "He seems perfectly sane (= completely sane ) to me."
"No sane person would want to kill a baby."

words.chinese: 使灰心； 挫败； 阻挠
words.definition: to prevent someone’s plans, efforts, or attempts from succeeding
examples: "Their attempts to speak to him were frustrated by the guards."

words.chinese: 华丽的， 绚丽的；令人十分愉快的， 极好的
words.definition: extremely pleasant or enjoyable
examples: "a gorgeous cake"
"The hotel room had a gorgeous view."

words.chinese: 腐蚀， 磨损；削弱， 减少
words.definition: the process by which rock or soil is gradually destroyed by wind, rain, or the sea
examples: "the problem of soil erosion"
"the erosion of the coastline"

words.chinese: 上升
words.definition: to move up through the air
examples: "The plane ascended rapidly."

words.chinese: 伤害， 损害， 危害；伤害， 损害， 危害
words.definition: damage, injury, or trouble caused by someone’s actions or by an event
examples: "The scandal did his career a lot of harm."
"Our children deserve protection from harm."

words.chinese: 倘若， 只要， 假如
examples: "He can come with us, provided he pays for his own meals."

words.chinese: 必不可少的， 必需的
words.definition: someone or something that is indispensable is so important or useful that it is impossible to manage without them
examples: "Mobile phones have become an indispensable part of our lives."

words.chinese: 透镜； 镜头
words.definition: the part of a camera through which the light travels before it reaches the film
examples: "a standard 50mm lens"

words.chinese: 体现， 使具体化
words.definition: to be a very good example of an idea or quality
examples: "She embodies everything I admire in a teacher."

words.chinese: 任何地方都不， 没有地方
words.definition: not in any place or to any place
examples: "Nowhere is drug abuse more of a problem than in the US."

words.chinese: 发动的； 运动的；动机， 目的 A
words.definition: the motive power or force for a machine, vehicle etc makes it move
examples: "Water provided the motive power for the mill."

words.chinese: 浪漫的， 传奇式的；不切实际的， 好幻想的
words.definition: showing strong feelings of love
examples: "‘Tom always sends me red roses on my birthday.’ ‘How romantic!’"

words.chinese: 展望， 想象；正视
words.definition: to think that something is likely to happen in the future
examples: "The scheme cost a lot more than we had originally envisaged."

words.chinese: 驱动， 驱使；激励
words.definition: to make someone want to achieve something and make them willing to work hard in order to do this
examples: "A good teacher has to be able to motivate her students."

words.chinese: 损坏， 破坏；宠坏， 溺爱
words.definition: to give a child everything they want, or let them do whatever they want, often with the result that they behave badly
examples: "She’s an only child, but they didn’t really spoil her."
"His mother and sisters spoil him rotten (= spoil him very much ) ."

words.chinese: 乘， 使相乘；繁殖；倍增， 增加
words.definition: to do a calculation in which you add a number to itself a particular number of times
examples: "Children will learn to multiply in the second grade."

words.chinese: 牧草地； 牧场
words.definition: land or a field that is covered with grass and is used for cattle, sheep etc to feed on
examples: "large areas of rough upland pasture"
"the lush pastures of the southern counties"

words.chinese: 赞成， 同意， 认可；批准 A
words.definition: when a plan, decision, or person is officially accepted
examples: "The president has already given his approval to the plan."
"It is just three months since we received official approval to go ahead with the project."
"A company cannot be sold without the approval of the shareholders."
"The bill will be submitted for approval by Congress."
"The President would appoint the Council of Ministers, subject to the approval of the National Assembly."
"The IMF has given its seal of approval to the government’s economic strategy."
"appointments requiring parliamentary approval"

words.chinese: 多样的， 多重的 ；倍数
words.definition: many, or involving many things, people, events etc
examples: "Baxter was rushed to the hospital with multiple stab wounds."
"Having multiple partners increases your risk of sexual diseases."
"His new album includes multiple versions of the same songs."

words.chinese: 通用的， 万用的；多才多艺的， 多方面的
words.definition: someone who is versatile has many different skills
examples: "a very versatile performer"
"a more versatile workforce"

words.chinese: 磁体； 磁铁
words.definition: a piece of iron or steel that can stick to metal or make other metal objects move towards itself
examples: "It's possible to hang a nail from a magnet and then use that nail to pick up another nail."

words.chinese: 使暴露， 受到 A；使曝光
words.definition: to put someone in a situation where they are not protected from something dangerous or unpleasant
examples: "He lifted his T-shirt to expose a jagged scar across his chest."

words.chinese: 集中， 专心 <；浓缩；浓缩物
words.definition: to think very carefully about something that you are doing
examples: "Now please concentrate."
"Adrian was finding it difficult to concentrate."

words.chinese: 与…相对， 与…相比；以…为对手， 对
words.definition: used to show that two people or teams are competing against each other in a game or court case
examples: "the New York Knicks versus the LA Lakers"
"the Supreme Court decision in Roe vs. Wade"

words.chinese: 爆炸； 爆发； 激增
words.definition: a loud sound and the energy produced by something such as a bomb bursting into small pieces
examples: "We heard a loud explosion."

words.chinese: 焊接， 锻接；焊接， 焊缝
words.definition: to join metals by melting their edges and pressing them together when they are hot
examples: "The new handle will have to be welded on."

words.chinese: 最新的，新式的
words.definition: including all the latest information
examples: "...the most up-to-date information available on foods today."

words.chinese: 许可， 允许；许可证， 执照
words.definition: to allow something to happen, especially by an official decision, rule, or law
examples: "Smoking is only permitted in the public lounge."
"He had more than the permitted level of alcohol in his blood."

words.chinese: 翻译；译文， 译本
words.definition: when you translate something, or something that has been translated
examples: "She read the letter and gave us a rough translation (= she did not translate everything exactly ) ."
"I’ve only read ‘Madame Bovary’ in translation (= not in its original language ) ."
"Much of the book’s humour has been lost in translation (= is no longer effective when translated ) ."

words.chinese: 全体人员， 全体职员 <；人事
words.definition: the people who work in a company, organization, or military force
examples: "All personnel are to receive security badges."

words.chinese: 癌
words.definition: a very serious disease in which cells in one part of the body start to grow in a way that is not normal
examples: "A lot of cancers can now be treated successfully."
"She was told last year that she had cancer ."
"He died of cancer last month."
"a new treatment which effectively kills cancer cells"

words.chinese: 简历
examples: "What do you do after being a spy? Do you sell insurance? And how do you get a new career when your resumé is blank?"

words.chinese: 景色， 风光；观点， 见解；展望， 前景
words.definition: what is expected to happen in the future
examples: "Exercise will improve your looks and your outlook."

words.chinese: 溅湿某人， 泼；溅， 飞溅声；引人注目的事物
words.definition: to make someone or something wet with a lot of small drops of water or other liquid
examples: "He closed his eyes tight, and splashed the water on his face."

words.chinese: 传奇， 爱情故事
words.definition: love, or a feeling of being in love
examples: "The romance had gone out of their relationship."

words.chinese: 瓷的； 瓷制的；瓷器
words.definition: a hard shiny white substance that is used for making expensive plates, cups etc
examples: "Yes, it is. You like porcelain?"

words.chinese: 目录；编目
examples: "Can you catalog all these books?"
"Well. this is our latest catalog."
"Can you send me a catalog?"

words.chinese: 神话；虚构的故事， 荒诞的说法
words.definition: an idea or story that many people believe, but which is not true
examples: "a book of Greek myths"

words.chinese: 奇异的， 幻想的， 异想天开的；极好的
words.definition: strange, unreal, and magical
examples: "fantastical creatures with golden wings and lions’ faces"

words.chinese: 含意， 暗示
words.definition: a suggestion that is not made directly but that people are expected to understand or accept
examples: "They are called ‘Supertrams’, the implication being that (= which is meant to suggest that ) they are more advanced than earlier models."

words.chinese: 面粉
words.definition: a powder that is made by crushing wheat or other grain and is used for making bread, cakes etc
examples: "You mix the flour and eggs like this, see."
"Put it in the flour without impairment of its surface."
"The fat and flour are rubbed together with the fingertips as for pastry."

words.chinese: 凶猛的， 残忍的；狂热的； 激烈的， 猛烈的
words.definition: done with a lot of energy and strong feelings, and sometimes violence
examples: "fierce fighting in the city"

words.chinese: 保留， 保留意见；预订
words.definition: an arrangement which you make so that a place in a hotel, restaurant, plane etc is kept for you at a particular time in the future
examples: "a dinner reservation"
"Customers are advised to make seat reservations well in advance."

words.chinese: 阻塞； 拦阻， 封锁；块； 木块； 石块；一片楼群； 街区；阻塞
words.definition: to prevent anything moving through a space by being or placing something across it or in it
examples: "A fallen tree is blocking the road."
"The sink’s blocked up."

words.chinese: 诚恳的； 亲切的； 热忱的
words.definition: friendly but quite polite and formal
examples: "The talks were conducted in a cordial atmosphere."

words.chinese: 胆怯的， 怯懦的
words.definition: not having courage or confidence
examples: "I was a timid child."

words.chinese: 与…商量， 商议；请教； 查阅

words.chinese: 忙乱， 大惊小怪；忙乱， 大惊小怪
